name: normwear
paper_title: Toward Foundation Model for Multivariate Wearable Sensing of Physiological Signals
authors: Yunfei Luo, Yuliang Chen, Asif Salekin, Tauhidur Rahman
venue: ACM Transactions on Computing for Healthcare (2025). Preprint: arXiv:2412.09758 (Dec 2024, rev. May 2025)
role: baseline (cosine/text-aligned tier) — the released open-vocab foundation model whose CWT-scalogram tokenizer most directly contests HALO's physical-Hz filterbank; must-have head-to-head.
notes: First multimodal wearable-sensing foundation model. Tokenization: continuous wavelet transform (CWT) scalograms per channel; channel-aware attention with a shared [CLS] liaison token (intra- + inter-sensor). Pretrained on ~2.5M multivariate segments / 14,943 h of PPG/ECG/EEG/GSR/IMU. Evaluated zero/partial/full-shot on 11 public datasets, 18 applications. Released code + weights. For HALO cross-check: rate/length-flexible via CWT (not physical-Hz-invariant by construction); physiological focus (not phone/watch HAR) — verify exact rate handling + IMU input format at adapter build.
